dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by multiple deep notches and tissue loss, preventing a smooth continuous spline fit; underlying morphology is falcate.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification and moderate pixel radius curvature transition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately steep anterior margin, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Dorsal fin base width is approximately 1.3 times the vertical pixel height from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent tissue loss on the trailing edge including one deep V-shaped notch near the apex and three smaller jagged indentations inferiorly; subtle circular depigmented lesions visible on the lateral body flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible mottled skin texture and small dark spots on the lower mid-flank area.
